# Inbound endpoint

One inbound endpoint of a DNS private resolver (`Microsoft.Network/dnsResolvers/inboundEndpoints`): a
private IP address in the resolver's virtual network that receives DNS queries and answers them with
Azure DNS and the private DNS zones linked to that network. The root module calls it once per endpoint;
it can also be called alone with the resolver's resource ID.

Without `private_ip_address` Azure assigns the subnet's fifth address (`.4` in `10.0.0.0/28`), which
changes only if the endpoint is created again. Azure cannot change an endpoint's subnet or address, so
changing either replaces the endpoint.

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: Azure region of the inbound endpoint: the resolver's.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: Name of the inbound endpoint. Changing it replaces the endpoint.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the DNS private resolver that holds the endpoint.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_subnet_id"></a> [subnet\_id](#input\_subnet\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the endpoint's subnet: in the resolver's virtual network, /28 to /24, delegated to `Microsoft.Network/dnsResolvers`, and used by no other endpoint or service. Changing it replaces the endpoint.

Type: `string`

## Optional Inputs

Description: Paths in the inbound endpoint's `body` whose changes the AzAPI provider ignores. Paths use dot notation, for example `properties.ipConfigurations`. Configuration changes at an ignored path are **not** sent to Azure until that path is removed from the list.

- `network_dns_resolvers_inbound_endpoints` - Ignored body paths for the inbound endpoint.

Type:

```hcl

    network_dns_resolvers_inbound_endpoints = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_private_ip_address"></a> [private\_ip\_address](#input\_private\_ip\_address)

Description: (Optional) A static IPv4 address for the endpoint, inside `subnet_id` and not one of the subnet's five reserved addresses. When null, Azure assigns one dynamically: the subnet's fifth address (`.4` in `10.0.0.0/28`), which changes only if the endpoint is created again. Changing it replaces the endpoint.

Default: `null`

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_lock_dependency"></a> [lock\_dependency](#output\_lock\_dependency)

Description: Changes whenever the endpoint is created, replaced or changed. The caller passes it in the resolver's `lock_dependencies`: Azure applies the resolver's lock to the endpoint too, and a `ReadOnly` lock also blocks updating it in place, which keeps its ID.

### <a name="output_name"></a> [name](#output\_name)

Description: Name of the inbound endpoint.

### <a name="output_private_ip_address"></a> [private\_ip\_address](#output\_private\_ip\_address)

Description: The endpoint's private IP address, static or assigned by Azure: the address on-premises DNS servers, a firewall's DNS proxy or a virtual network's DNS settings forward to.

### <a name="output_resource_id"></a> [resource\_id](#output\_resource\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the inbound endpoint.
